stem:
Vivek opens a compass to a fixed length, keeps the metal point fixed at P, and moves only the pencil.

What path does the pencil draw?

options.text: A circle whose radius is the point P.
A circle with centre at the moving pencil tip, and with P on the rim.
A circle with centre P, and with every pencil point at the same fixed distance from P.
A square that has one corner fixed at P.

teacher.key_rationale: Fixed compass opening with the point held at P makes every pencil mark the same distance from P, so the path is the circle centred at P.
